csv_scope_of_work: The State of Montana , Department of Transportation , may be seeking a Consultant to Provide Ninemile Structure Study. Other (OT) phase study to determine path forward for two bridges in the Ninemile area-specifically to determine abandonment/replacement options. The study will consider new alignment in order to potentially reduce the size (and impacts) of replacement structures.

title: Consultant for Ninemile Structure Study
short_description: Study for abandonment or replacement options for two bridges in Ninemile, Montana.
project_scope: Advance notice for a study concerning two bridges in the Ninemile area. The study is to determine the path forward, specifically abandonment versus replacement options, and will consider a new alignment to potentially reduce the size and impacts of replacement structures. No technical dimensions, spans, or bridge types are stated.
services: Consulting and study services in the OT phase, including civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, traffic design engineering, and traffic studies for two bridge structures.
relevance_explanation:
- Bridge-related project with structural engineering scope, which is generally relevant to sbp.
- Involves evaluating replacement options and possible new alignment for two bridges.
- Early strategic entry via study phase can be valuable.
- However, this is only an advance notice and currently a study, not a defined bridge design commission.
- No information on spans, structural complexity, innovative features, or sustainability ambitions.
- Includes broad multidisciplinary scope, with structural engineering only one part of the assignment.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. The project is currently only a structure study for two bridges, assessing abandonment/replacement options and possible realignment. No span lengths, bridge types, quantities, or replacement concept are provided, so a realistic construction cost estimate is not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The notice is only an advance notice for a study assignment.
